title: Install and Configure pgvector Extension
description: Install pgvector 0.7+ in the PostgreSQL Docker image. Update all docker-compose files to use the pgvector-enabled image. Configure HNSW index parameters (m=16, ef_construction=200). Verify CREATE EXTENSION vector works in fresh database setup.
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL Docker image includes pgvector 0.7+ extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector succeeds on fresh database
vector(1536) column type available for text-embedding-3-small dimensions
HNSW index creation with cosine operator class works
All docker-compose files reference the updated image
Seed script handles pgvector extension check
